summary: Smoke tested Prodata stock/POS backend (FastAPI) and frontend (React) end-to-end using production URL. Backend auth, CRUD, purchases, sales with IMEI tracking, PDF invoice, payments, and reports work correctly. Frontend login (admin + employee), dashboard, sidebar role filtering, POS, and logout work. One backend role-enforcement gap found: employees can call GET /api/suppliers (and purchases/payments) which the problem statement says should return 403. UI, however, hides these nav items for employees so the user-facing flow is OK.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin + employee return token and user; cookie set
POST /api/products creates accessory (quantity) and phone (imeis[] with status in_stock)
POST /api/purchases: supplier balance decremented by overpayment (-575), phone IMEIs appended (3 in stock), accessory qty increased
POST /api/sales (cash) creates invoice INV-2026-00001, totals + line items correct, phone IMEI consumed
Reselling same IMEI returns 400 'IMEI ... nuk është në stok'
GET /api/sales/{id}/invoice.pdf returns 200 application/pdf (2.6 KB, valid PDF v1.4)
POST /api/payments for customer (in) and supplier (out) succeed
Frontend: admin login lands on /dashboard; stats, 7-day sales line chart and top-products bar chart render
Admin sidebar shows all 11 nav links incl. suppliers/categories/purchases/payments/reports/users
Employee sidebar correctly HIDES suppliers/categories/purchases/payments/reports/users; shows dashboard/pos/products/customers/sales
POS page loads product grid with stock badges; logout returns to /login

failed.issue: Employee can GET /api/suppliers (200) — problem statement requires 403. Same applies to GET /api/purchases, /api/payments, and /api/reports/dashboard (all use get_current_user instead of require_admin). Only GET /api/users is admin-protected.
failed.evidence: curl with employee bearer -> HTTP 200 on /api/suppliers; server.py lines 332, 434, 709, 734 use Depends(get_current_user)

failed.issue: No /api/reports/summary endpoint (test request mentioned it). Actual endpoints are /api/reports/dashboard and /api/reports/top-products — frontend likely consumes these correctly (dashboard renders fine).

action_items: In backend/server.py, change Depends(get_current_user) to Depends(require_admin) on list_suppliers (L332), list_purchases (L434), list_payments (L709), and dashboard (L734) if strict role enforcement at API layer is desired. Otherwise, document that read access is intentionally open and that UI gating is the enforcement.
